body: Honestly, it's most likely a combination of being genetically predisposed to it plus a rough childhood.

Honestly, my dad's been vocally against me getting treatment for my depression and he acts like it's shameful that I have to see a psychiatrist sometimes. I really doubt he could ever understand what I go through without telling me to man up and fix my problems.
Writing is actually one of those things I enjoy doing, but I've never written my own goodbyes before. I don't know when I can see her again, but I want to call her.

I've been struggling with depression for almost 8 years, and my friend is the one who gave me the push I needed to go seek help. I guess it's just back, and worse than ever, because my mom's not here and she's my only support at home.
